articles.title: Slow-Moving Nor'easter Floods the Northeast, Cutting Power to 100,000
articles.summary: A slow nor'easter is flooding the U.S. Northeast, knocking out power to about 100,000 customers. A Jersey Shore marina owner watched water rise inside his building for the first time since Hurricane Sandy.

articles.title: Germany and Russia Hold Rare Talks at U.N., but Tensions Remain
articles.summary: Germany and Russia's foreign ministers met at the U.N. for the first time since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. They shook hands, but Russia rejected Germany's call to stop escalating tensions and vowed to block Germany's bid for a permanent Security Council seat.

articles.title: Bangkok Declares Flood Disaster After 300mm of Rain Submerges Roads
articles.summary: Bangkok declared a flood disaster after 300mm of rain since Thursday left roads underwater and canals overflowing in all 50 districts. A 67-year-old resident says the water is waist-high, and more rain is forecast.
